component.name: Kerberus
component.summary: Get, renew and destroy Kerberos tickets

description.p: Kerberus shows the Kerberos tickets in your credential caches and keeps them from running out. It works with the machine's own krb5.conf and caches, so tickets it gets are the ones kinit and klist see.

ul.li: When an app needs to sign in with Kerberos and you have no ticket, ask which identity to use, and let the app carry on once you have
Stay in the tray, showing whether you're signed in
See every principal in the cache collection, when its tickets expire and how long they can be renewed
Sign in, renew, switch the default principal and destroy tickets
Renew tickets automatically before they expire, in the background if you like
Optionally keep the password in the keyring to sign in again when a ticket can't be renewed
Change your Kerberos password, including one that has expired
